span.p:
Reward_WormLoco.Step(distance, τ&̂, uprightDot, jerk, skate)
NaN/Inf firewall on all five inputs

div.style: color: rgb(13, 61, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
progress = clamp(Δdistance, ±0.2 m) · 1.0 (telescoping, unscaled)
−0.05τ&̂² +0.02·upright&⁺ −0.01·jerk −0.025·skate −0.002
all five shaping terms × stepScale = Δt / 0.02 = 0.25

span.p:
DecisionRequester
DecisionPeriod = 20
TakeActionsBetweenDecisions = 1
→ new decision every 0.1 s;
the last action is re-applied on the
19 ticks in between

div.style: color: rgb(58, 40, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent_Creature.CollectObservations(VectorSensor)
N×3 + 19 floats, every value through Safe()
per joint: jointPosition/(scale·deg2rad), jointVelocity/10, isGrounded
+ root.up(3), root.y(1), goalDir_local(3), dist/20(1),
vel_local/2(3), angVel_local/20(3), stamina(1), 4 terrain probes

div.style: color: rgb(58, 40, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent_Creature.OnActionReceived(ActionBuffers)
clamp to [-1,1] → xDrive.target = a · 45°
jerk = mean |a_t − a_(t−1)|

div.style: color: rgb(58, 40, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fatigue — torque read from jointForce, NOT the action
overload = (τ&̂ − 0.5)/0.5 → stamina −0.25/s, recovery +0.15/s
power factor = lerp(0.55, 1, stamina) scales stiffness + forceLimit
written only when |Δfactor| > 0.005

div.style: color: rgb(58, 40, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PhysX solves the articulation
ArticulationBody PD drive per DOF,
torque clamped to forceLimit

div.style: color: rgb(74, 15, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Diverged root.y < −1 m
or dist > 500 m or NaN
−1 → EndEpisode()

div.style: color: rgb(74, 15, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stalled no >0.05 m gain
for 20 s = 4000 steps
−0.5 → EpisodeInterrupted()
truncation: value bootstrapped

div.style: color: rgb(74, 15, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OnEpisodeBegin
1. RestoreDriveBaseline() — fatigue cleared BEFORE motors
2. stamina = 1, previousActions = 0
3. areaReset() re-authors drives + quirks
4. reward.Reset(distanceToGoal)
